name: AWS Secrets Manager GitHub Action
description: GitHub action for retrieving secrets from AWS Secrets Manager

secret-ids.description: One or more secret names, secret ARNs, or secret prefixes to retrieve

parse-json-secrets.description: (Optional) If true, JSON secrets will be deserialized, creating a secret environment variable for each key-value pair.

name-transformation.description: (Optional) Transforms environment variable name. Options: uppercase, lowercase, none. Default value: uppercase.

auto-select-family-attempt-timeout.description: (Optional) Timeout (ms) for dual-stack DNS first IP connection attempt. Needed for geographically distant GitHub action workers
